# Muse Skills

> Universal AI agent skills for Project OS scaffolding, memory synchronization, PIP performance enforcement, subagent orchestration, design-system extraction, Refactoring UI design heuristics, and Linus Torvalds style code review across the LifeOS ecosystem.

## Core Documentation
- [Repository README](README.md): Overview, quick start, installation, and skill matrices.
- [Architecture & Design](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): System architecture, execution flows, and integration model.
- [Skill Specification](docs/SKILL_SPECIFICATION.md): RFC authoring standard for skills.
- [Changelog](docs/CHANGELOG.md): Version release history and semantic changelog.
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): Meaningful Git Commit Protocol.

## Published Skills Catalog
- [new-project](new-project/SKILL.md): (Flagship) Interactive Project OS & Governance Scaffolder.
- [updateagents](updateagents/SKILL.md): (Flagship) Automatic Workspace Memory & Context Synchronizer.
- [pua](pua/SKILL.md): PIP Performance Improvement Plan & Hardcore Debugging.
- [agent-handoff](agent-handoff/SKILL.md): Structured Subagent Context Packet Generator.
- [dead-letter](dead-letter/SKILL.md): Failed/Blocked Task Triage & Escalation Generator.
- [context-anchor](context-anchor/SKILL.md): Working Reference Drift Prevention Snapshot.
- [designscope](designscope/SKILL.md): Design System Extraction (design.md + DTCG Tokens + WCAG) from Images, URLs & Figma.
- [code-review-linus-torvalds-style](code-review-linus-torvalds-style/SKILL.md): Code Review - Linus Torvalds Style (Correctness, Invariants, Special-Case Elimination).
- [refactor-ui](refactor-ui/SKILL.md): Atomic UI Design & Interface Refactoring Engine (10 Heuristics from Refactoring UI).
